fact: The Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation says it is developing a comprehensive Data Governance Framework setting how government data is classified, shared and used across institutions; no adoption is stated.

DIAL says it supported the Government in a five-month 2025 engagement to update and refine the National Data Strategy to align with the African Union Data Policy Framework, with consultations informing its drafting; the page does not say the update was approved or launched (dated by its published year).

fact: The report says the Ministry's training of the DSTI technical team is part of its efforts to implement the National Data Strategy, which it describes as treating data as a public asset; no adoption date is given.

The Ministry of Information and Communications published the National Data Strategy, the country's first, dated January 2023 and carrying the Minister's foreword and the Permanent Secretary's preface; the document gives no end date.
Sierra Leone validated its National Data Governance Strategy in Freetown on 7-8 August 2025, hosted by MoCTI, with finalising and adopting it listed by KICTANet as a next step.

The Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation reports a two-day technical validation workshop that reviewed the draft National Data Strategy, called the final stage before the strategy's launch.
A Government of Sierra Leone presentation says a National Data Strategy is in ongoing development, with March 2025 given as its date.

Sierra Leone's communications ministry (MoCTI) hosted a focus group discussion with government, civil society, academia, tech, media and private-sector participants on its draft National Data Governance Strategy, Sierraloaded reports.
